children.content: Upload your DBS certificate to earn the 'DBS Verified' badge

props.heading: Why submit a DBS certificate?
props.message:
Stand out to families — caregivers with 'DBS Verified' badge receive more bookings. Prepare for Tier 2 — personal care services require mandatory DBS. Meet care sector standards — show your commitment to safety.

DBS checks are VOLUNTARY for companionship services (Tier 1). You can activate your profile without submitting.

props.dragDropText: Drag and drop your DBS certificate here, or click to browse

props.helpText: Certificate number helps admin verify authenticity (optional)

upload.description: Default state - form ready for DBS certificate upload

pending-review.description: DBS submitted, awaiting admin review (48 hours)

props.message: Your DBS certificate has been submitted and is awaiting admin review. This typically takes 48 hours.

approved.description: DBS verified - Enhanced level badge awarded

props.heading: Your DBS certificate has been verified.
props.message: Certificate Level: Enhanced. Issue Date: 15 Jan 2023. Verified on: 12 Feb 2026. You now have the 'DBS Verified' badge on your profile!

props.heading: Your DBS certificate was rejected.
props.message:
Reason: Certificate expired (issued 4 years ago, >3 year best practice). Please obtain a new DBS certificate.

How to obtain a new DBS: Via umbrella body (Trustid, UKCBC, Disclosure Scotland). Cost: £40-60 (self-funded at Tier 1). Processing time: 4-8 weeks (Enhanced level).

skipped.description: DBS submission skipped - profile can still activate

props.heading: You skipped DBS certificate submission.
props.message:
Your profile can still be activated without DBS. You can add DBS certificate later from Settings > Verification.

Remember: Caregivers with 'DBS Verified' badge receive more booking requests from families.

certificate-old-warning.description: Non-blocking warning when certificate is >3 years old

props.message: Warning: Certificate issued 4 years ago. DBS best practice recommends renewal every 3 years. You can still submit, but admin may request newer DBS.
